This job leads and influences standard operations of the designated end to end TAX processes and recommends and implements input for the organizational, operational and stakeholder model for the shared services. This job also monitors and implements improvements key performance indicators and metrics and partners to lead specific projects to drive efficiencies. The Tax Supervisor, also coaches and empowers the team to deliver standard services, managing them to achieve the organization’s goals, by ensuring productivity and supporting employee development.
He/she partners with TAX Advisors and Business to ensure the operational compliance.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • TAX RETURNS & TAX FORM COMPLETION: Reviews moderately complex tax returns, and reviews tax forms and related documents associated with tax compliance, including provisions, computations, estimates, and extensions. Ensures timely TAX Payments, and reviews Tax incentives calculation.

title: Head of Credit & Risk, Amazon Payments
description:
Are you looking for a new challenge in a fast‑paced, innovative company? Come make history with Amazon's Brazil team! We are seeking a strategic and business‑savvy Credit Risk Principal to drive our credit initiatives in Brazil and create access to affordable payment methods. You will own the vision and roadmap to scale our digital credit products, working with global teams to support launches and management of new products.

The ideal candidate possesses strong credit risk management experience, deep understanding of Brazil's Payments and financial products competitive landscape, and a proven track record leading large‑scale projects. You must be able to thrive in an entrepreneurial environment and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities when scaling a business in a new geography.

Key Job Responsibilities
  • Own and drive the end‑to‑end credit risk strategy, balancing growth, profitability, and loss mitigation across products and customer segments.
  • Define and evolve credit risk frameworks, including underwriting policies, risk appetite, decision rules, and governance models.
  • Lead the fraud & abuse strategy, partnering with Fraud, Trust & Safety teams to prevent first‑party misuse, synthetic identity, and emerging fraud patterns.
  • Design and optimise collections and recovery strategies, including segmentation, treatment paths, vendor strategy, and in‑house vs. outsourced models.
  • Develop and monitor risk KPIs and performance metrics (FPD, NPL, loss rates, recovery curves, fraud loss, customer friction).
  • Partner closely with Product, Data Science, Engineering, Finance and Legal/Compliance to embed risk controls into customer journeys and system design.
  • Drive data‑driven decision‑making, leveraging advanced analytics, experimentation, and predictive models to continuously improve risk outcomes.
  • Identify and assess new risk vectors related to product launches, policy changes, or market expansion, proposing scalable mitigation strategies.
  • Influence senior leadership and stakeholders through clear narratives, trade‑off analysis and risk‑return recommendations.
  • Act as a subject‑matter expert in credit risk and set best practices across the organization.
  • Support regulatory, audit and internal review processes, ensuring compliance with local and global risk requirements.
About the Team

Brazil Payments is part of the International Emerging Stores Payments team and focuses on supporting the launch of new payment and financial products to our customers in Brazil.

Basic Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Experience in communication and presentation skills, both written and verbal in Portuguese & English
  • Solid experience in compliance, audit or risk management
Preferred Qualifications
  • Master's degree, or MBA in BI, finance, engineering, statistics, computer science, mathematics, finance or equivalent quantitative field
  • Deep expertise in credit underwriting, collections strategy and fraud prevention across consumer lending products in Latin American markets, particularly Brazil.
  • Proven track record designing and implementing credit risk frameworks that balanced growth targets with loss mitigation in high‑growth environments.
  • Experience in credit risk management
  • Experience in a leadership role within financial services, fintech, or payments industry.

title: Gerente/Coordenador De Produto
description:
A busca por posições de gerente coordenador de produto está aquecida, refletindo a demanda crescente por profissionais capacitados para liderar e otimizar o desenvolvimento de produtos . Empresas de diversos setores buscam indivíduos com habilidades em gestão de projetos , análise de mercado e coordenação de equipes multidisciplinares . Oportunidades para gerentes coordenadores de produto abrangem desde startups inovadoras até grandes corporações estabelecidas.

Profissionais que almejam essa função devem possuir experiência comprovada em gerenciamento de produtos , conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e capacidade de tomar decisões estratégicas. A familiaridade com ferramentas de análise de dados e a habilidade de comunicar de forma clara e eficaz são diferenciais importantes. A certificação em Product Management pode ser um diferencial na busca por vagas.

O mercado de trabalho para gerentes coordenadores de produto oferece salários competitivos e oportunidades de crescimento profissional. A capacidade de adaptação a um ambiente dinâmico e a busca constante por atualização são características valorizadas pelas empresas. A demanda por esses profissionais tende a se manter alta, impulsionada pela crescente importância da inovação e da experiência do cliente.

O que as pessoas perguntam

Um gerente coordenador de produto é responsável por definir a visão e estratégia do produto, coordenar o desenvolvimento com equipes de engenharia e design, e garantir que o produto atenda às necessidades dos clientes e objetivos da empresa. Ele também analisa o mercado, acompanha a concorrência e define o roadmap do produto. A comunicação eficaz e a capacidade de tomar decisões baseadas em dados são cruciais.

Para se tornar um gerente coordenador de produto, é preciso ter experiência em gestão de produtos, conhecimento em metodologias ágeis , habilidades de comunicação e liderança , e capacidade de análise de dados. Graduação em áreas como administração, engenharia ou marketing é comum, e certificações em Product Management podem ser um diferencial. A experiência em desenvolvimento de software ou áreas técnicas relacionadas também é valorizada.

A faixa salarial para um gerente coordenador de produto no Brasil pode variar bastante dependendo da experiência, localização e tamanho da empresa. No entanto, geralmente, um profissional nessa posição pode esperar ganhar entre $ 8.00 0 e $ 20.00 0 por mês. Essa estimativa pode ser influenciada por bônus e outros benefícios oferecidos pela empresa.

Um gerente coordenador de produto pode progredir para cargos de liderança , como diretor de produto , head de produto ou até mesmo posições executivas. A experiência em gestão de produtos também pode abrir portas para empreender e criar sua própria empresa. A busca constante por atualização e o desenvolvimento de novas habilidades são importantes para avançar na carreira.

Alguns dos principais empregadores para gerentes coordenadores de produto no Brasil incluem empresas de tecnologia como Magazine Luiza, Mercado Livre e grandes bancos como Itaú e Bradesco. Startups em crescimento e empresas de consultoria também oferece oportunidades nessa área. A demanda por esses profissionais é alta em diversos setores da economia.

Bahia, instituição filantrópica que se propõe ao objetivo de ajudar aos mais necessitados.

Foi no ano de 1549, quando Tomé de Sousa ocupava o posto de governador-geral do Brasil, que foi construída uma casa de taipa e palha, no Centro Histórico de Salvador, que por cerca de 200 anos abrigou o Hospital de Caridade, primeiro hospital do Estado da Bahia, sendo o único a prestar assistência aos baianos na época.

Somente em 30 de julho de 1893 foi construído o Hospital Santa Izabel (HSI), no bairro de Nazaré, em Salvador, desativando a antiga unidade de saúde que funcionava no Pelourinho. O prédio do primeiro hospital passou a ser a sede administrativa da Santa Casa da Bahia e, em 2006, se tornou o Museu da Misericórdia.

Ria Money Transfer, a business segment of Euronet Worldwide, Inc. We believe we can create a world in which people are empowered to build the life they dream of, no matter who they are or where they are. One customer, one family, one community at a time.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

We are seeking an experienced Data Engineer to join our dynamic Data team. If you’re passionate about transforming raw data into actionable insights, this role offers an exciting opportunity to work with a best‑in‑class cloud data architecture. You will help power a data ecosystem driven by 280 million annual visitors across our web and app platforms, leveraging an enterprise‑grade, event‑based stack to unlock limitless possibilities. In this role, you’ll have the freedom to design and build robust data pipelines, integrate diverse data sources, and create meaningful business insights that accelerate product innovation and growth. If you also excel at API design and cloud‑native services, this is the perfect opportunity to make an impact.

ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Design, develop, and maintain high‑performance API services to meet diverse data requirements.
  • Build and manage robust ETL pipelines in Python, leveraging AWS ECS for real‑time processing and AWS Glue and Lambda for batch workflows.
  • Build and manage real‑time data pipelines using AWS Kinesis Data Streams and Firehose for efficient ingestion and delivery to target destinations.
  • Administer raw and curated datasets in AWS S3 to support scalable data lake architectures.
  • Provide AWS Athena tables to enable advanced querying and analytics for serverless data insights.
  • Create and maintain relational databases and tables on AWS RDS (PostgreSQL) and AWS Athena to support scalable data solutions.
  • Design and implement data models to support efficient storage, retrieval, and analytics across structured and unstructured datasets.
  • Monitor system health and performance using observability tools such as AWS CloudWatch, Grafana, and Datadog.
  • Implement best practices in cloud‑native development, CI/CD, automation, and Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, collaborating with the DevOps team.
  • Optimize all components for cost efficiency, performance, reliability, and security.
  • Collaborate closely with Data Scientists, ML Engineers, and System Engineers to deliver data‑driven solutions.
POSITION REQUIREMENTS
  • Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • 3+ years of practical experience in Data Engineering, including the design, development, and optimisation of data pipelines and workflows.
  • Proficiency in Python, with demonstrated expertise in both object‑oriented and service‑oriented programming paradigms.
  • Familiarity with PySpark for distributed data processing and scalable ETL workflows on AWS Glue is an added plus.
  • Strong command of SQL, data warehousing techniques, and management of both structured and unstructured datasets.
  • Experience working with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, AWS Neptune), including designing schemas and ingesting data for complex relationship modeling and querying.
  • Hands‑on experience with AWS Glue, Lambda, S3, Athena, RDS Aurora PostgreSQL, DynamoDB, and ECS.
  • Experience maintaining GitHub repositories, including overseeing branching strategies and collaborating closely with DevOps teams on code merges.
  • Familiarity with containerisation technologies such as Docker and Docker Compose.
  • Comfortable operating within an Agile framework, utilising Jira for project management and sprint planning.
  • Exceptional communication and collaboration abilities, with proven experience engaging effectively with internal stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of cloud security best practices, and compliance frameworks.
  • Nice to have: Strong understanding of privacy requirements, data security protocols, and regulatory standards.

Overview

The First Mile team is looking for an SPC Shift Manager to join our Seller Processing Center in Embu das Artes, SP. Do you want to work hard, have fun, and make history? If so, Amazon could be the right career choice for you. Every day, our logistics teams are redefining how we serve customers around the world, tackling some of the biggest challenges in the logistics industry, not just for Amazon, but for the entire sector.

Amazon’s transportation teams ensure that packages of all sizes reach our customers quickly and reliably. As an SPC Station Leader, you will lead daily operations in a Seller Processing Center, managing Team Leads, Associates, and Delivery Service Providers. You will also be responsible for overseeing performance and relationships with external staffing agencies.

This is a hands‑on role in a highly collaborative, fast‑paced environment that feels more like a startup than a large corporation. We believe the best ideas are the ones we test and learn from, and we welcome innovation at every level.

Success in this role requires strong ownership, adaptability, and a customer‑obsessed mindset. If you have experience leading teams in dynamic, high‑growth environments, we’d love to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
  • Being based at one of our Seller Processing Centers (SPCs), working day and night shifts. As Amazon operates 24/7, this role requires flexibility to work weekends and holidays as part of a rotating schedule.
  • Overseeing large‑scale operations focused on the pickup of Amazon orders from sellers and ensuring timely handoff to last mile stations for final delivery to customers.
  • Supporting a team of operational leaders in the daily management of the SPC. Responsibilities include labor planning, leading shift briefings, assigning tasks, and coordinating with both internal teams and external partners.
  • Managing key performance indicators (KPIs) such as On‑Time Dispatch and Estimate Arrival Date, while continuously improving customer experience and operational efficiency.
  • Thinking analytically about projects and operations, with strong attention to detail, the ability to influence others, and excellent organizational skills.
  • Demonstrating a metrics‑driven mindset, diving deep to identify root causes and drive sustainable improvements.
  • Delivering practical, scalable solutions to complex problems without compromising quality or core functionality. Leveraging exceptional problem‑solving and communication skills to influence both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Providing hands‑on support during the rollout and implementation of new systems or processes, and gathering feedback for continuous improvement.
  • Mapping business requirements, analyzing current processes, and designing solutions to improve workflow and efficiency.
  • Using software and hardware tools to support day‑to‑day operations, ensuring associates have the resources they need and coordinating repairs or replacements when necessary.
  • Communicating daily metrics and operational exceptions to relevant teams within Operations and across Amazon.
  • Maintaining availability to work a variety of shifts based on business needs, including overnights, weekends, and holidays.

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent
  • Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
  • Speak, write, and read fluently in English
  • Employee and performance management experience
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with performance metrics and process improvement and Lean techniques
  • Experience in logistics and e-commerce environments is preferred

Job Description Summary:

At The Coca-Cola Company, we are proud to be one of the world’s most recognized and respected brands, with a legacy spanning over 139 years and a portfolio of more than 200 brands enjoyed by millions globally. Our mission is simple yet powerful: refresh the world and make a difference.

We are seeking a Director, Scientific & Regulatory Affairs (SRA) Brazil to provide scientific and regulatory leadership across one of our most strategically important markets. This role is pivotal in protecting and expanding the Company’s freedom to operate by ensuring portfolio compliance, enabling innovation, and actively shaping the external regulatory environment through science‑based advocacy . The ideal candidate will bring deep scientific expertise, strong regulatory judgment, and the ability to influence policy and business decisions through credibility and collaboration.

If you are passionate about science‑led advocacy, regulatory leadership, and enabling responsible growth, we want you on our team.

What You’ll Do for Us
  • Lead the execution of the Scientific & Regulatory Affairs agenda for Brazil, aligning scientific, regulatory, and advocacy activities with business priorities and regional and global SRA direction.
  • Engage in science‑based regulatory advocacy , contributing technical expertise and evidence to help shape policies, standards, and guidance that impact the Company’s portfolio and future innovation.
  • Serve as the scientific and regulatory authority for claims and marketing communications evaluation and approval , ensuring compliance, credibility, and appropriate substantiation.
  • Ensure compliance continuity across the full portfolio after product launch.
  • Partner closely with Marketing, R&D, Legal, Public Affairs, and Franchise teams to anticipate regulatory risks and enable compliant, timely business decisions.
  • Monitor and assess emerging scientific, regulatory, and public policy trends, translating complexity into clear implications and recommendations for senior leaders.
  • Support the market on IMCRs (Incident Management and Crisis Response) , providing scientific and regulatory expertise to enable effective, timely, and compliant responses.
  • Represent the Company with regulators, industry associations, and scientific forums as appropriate, building credibility and constructive dialogue.
Requirements & Qualifications
  • Advanced degree in Food Science, Nutrition, Toxicology, Chemistry, Biology, Public Health, or a related scientific discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience in scientific and/or regulatory affairs within food, beverage, consumer goods, pharmaceutical, or similarly regulated industries.
  • Strong knowledge of Brazilian regulatory frameworks, with demonstrated experience engaging with ANVISA and other relevant authorities.
  • Proven expertise in regulatory advocacy, claims substantiation, labeling, marketing communications review, and product compliance across the product life cycle.
  • Ability to influence cross‑functional and external stakeholders in a matrixed organization without direct people management responsibility.
  • Strong judgment, analytical thinking, and comfort operating in complex, evolving regulatory environments.
  • Experience working in emerging markets and within global organizations strongly preferred.
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English; Spanish proficiency is a plus.
What We'll do for You
  • Global Exposure: Collaborate with regional and global SRA leaders, contributing Brazilian perspectives to enterprise‑level scientific and regulatory strategies.
  • Iconic Brands: Support some of the world’s most trusted and loved brands within a system grounded in science, integrity, and responsibility.
  • Learning & Development: Access continuous scientific learning, regulatory forums, and professional development opportunities.
  • Purpose‑Driven Work: Play a meaningful role in advancing science‑based policy and enabling sustainable, responsible business growth.
Skills

Active Listening, Analytical Thinking, Communication, Cross-Functional Teamwork, Food Sciences, Food Technology, Government Affairs, Leadership, organization, Regulatory Advocacy, Regulatory Environment, Regulatory Issues, Regulatory Policies, Risk Management, Strategic Influence, Taking Initiative

Our Purpose and Growth Culture

We are taking deliberate action to nurture an inclusive culture that is grounded in our company purpose, to refresh the world and make a difference. We act with a growth mindset, take an expansive approach to what’s possible and believe in continuous learning to improve our business and ourselves. We focus on four key behaviors – curious, empowered, inclusive and agile – and value how we work as much as what we achieve. We believe that our culture is one of the reasons our company continues to thrive after 130+ years. Visit Our Purpose and Vision to learn more about these behaviors and how you can bring them to life in your next role at Coca-Cola.

  • Manage the calculation and execution of monthly tax payments and annual tax returns for all Brazilian legal entities.

  • Lead and develop a team of seven tax professionals , fostering capability building, engagement, and high performance.

  • Strong command of global reporting standards and their application in multinational environments.
  • Experience in the Food Industry is a strong plus.

  • Strong experience with Microsoft Dynamics , including system navigation, data management, and process optimization.
Education Background
  • Bachelor’s in law, Accounting or Economics is mandatory.
  • Postgraduate/Master degree specialization in Tax is desirable.

Em 2017, a Companhia realizou seu primeiro investimento ao adquirir o Vera Cruz Hospital, localizado na cidade Campinas-SP, que com mais de 80 anos de atuação, é um dos mais tradicionais hospitais da cidade. O hospital atualmente conta com 11 salas cirúrgicas, 08 leitos de Apoio Cirúrgico, 110 leitos de internação, 14 leitos de UTI Adulto, 10 leitos de Unidade Cardiológica, 10 leitos Semi-intensiva, 16 leitos Maternidade/Alojamento Conjunto, 09 leitos Pediatria e Pronto Socorro 24h. Além de atender mais de 66 especialidades, ter acreditação ONA 3e ter conquistado em 2025 a importantíssima acreditação da JCI.

Desde então, por meio do Vera Cruz Hospital, aumentamos nossa rede de forma substancial em Campinas e região. Com a inauguração, por exemplo, de serviços novos como os Centros de Oncologia, Neurologia, Cardiologia, Ortopedia, a Unidade de Atenção Primária da Saúde e a criação das unidades avançadas em Indaiatuba.

Nesse mesmo processo de consolidação regional, adquirimos também a operadora de saúde Vera Cruz, atualmente denominada 2Care.

A regional faz parte do grupo Hospital Care que em 2017, a união das pessoas com o sonho de transformar a saúde suplementar do Brasil, possibilitou o início da trajetória da companhia. Somos uma holding administradora de serviços de saúde que propõe um modelo inovador de gestão integrada, tendo como objetivo promover o equilíbrio de interesses entre pacientes, médicos, fontes pagadoras, parceiros e acionistas. Como estratégia de atuação, está presente em cidades que funcionam como polos regionais para a gestão de saúde, dentro de três estados, São Paulo, Paraná e Florianópolis. Esse conjunto de operações tem como objetivo nos tornar a melhor Rede de Prestadores de Saúde Privada do Brasil.

Ensure functions work together in an integrated manner to deliver results. Forge opportunities for innovation and continuous improvement to drive above‑market top‑line sales growth and maximize efficiency and improve margin. Internal and External Stakeholder Management - Understand the needs and expectations of internal stakeholders (e.g. other GMs, functional leaders, senior leaders, etc.) and external stakeholders (e.g. regulatory/compliance entities, governments, associations, etc.). Initiate, maintain and tactfully influence relationships with various medical and non‑medical stakeholders. Align the interests of different stakeholders to drive common goals, driving aggressive reconciliation when necessary. Proactively engage key opinion leaders to shape and reinforce the Abbott brand and image. Proactively engage in building relationships to influence policy makers. Build and manage relationships with government affairs institutions. Represent self, equal to the Abbott brand, when in the community and with various external stakeholders. Compliance - Develop operating policies consistent with Abbott’s broad policies and objectives and ensures their implementation. Ensures that activities and operations are carried out in compliance with local, state and federal regulations and laws governing business operations.

Reports to the Divisional Vice President global commercial operations. Acts independently restricted by only the policies and objectives to carry out the assignments/responsibilities given by management and ensures that the objectives set for such assignments are met. Has authority to establish sales policies/procedures and to set goals, priorities and systems that affect the future direction of the commercial organization. Develops organizational strategy/planning to carry out divisional goals, accountable for the contribution of the commercial organization to the long‑term needs of LAC, Infectious Diseases. Implements organizational planning/development programs providing necessary resources, both short and long term, and ensures the attainment of profit and operational goals for the LAC commercial organization. Anticipates and resolves the highest level of problems/issues that could impact the operational success; manages conflicting objectives. Accountable for administrative and operational decisions affecting the commercial organization. These decisions would have maximum effect on the success or failure of the LAC, ID commercial organization, as well as having a direct effect on the division and corporation meeting its overall‑long‑term objectives.

Relationships Internal

Interfaces with senior executive management within the Company. Participates in and approves staffing and organizational structure. Serves as the principal spokesperson for the LAC, Infectious Diseases commercial organization on matters of significance to the Division/Abbott. Provides an overall environment that facilitates employee development, growth and performance. Sets strategic direction for the LAC, ID commercial organization.

External

Interacts with sales representatives, physicians, key vendors, key opinion leaders (KOLs), customers, agents and representatives of cognizant governmental agencies and corporations.

  • Knowledge of Diagnostics, Medical Device and/or Software as Service (SaS) industry.
  • Proven experience in developing turnaround strategies, leading change, restructuring operations, optimizing resources and building remediation plans.
  • Proven track record of developing strategies and tactics to maintain and grow share in a competitive and volatile environment.

  • Prior experience of running a full P&L at affiliate and/or regional level. Demonstrated expertise in price – value contract negotiations. Thorough understanding of financial dynamics (pricing, return on investment, contract management and additional cost justification).
  • Operational mindset to drive projects from inception to completion.
  • Ability to form and lead cross‑functional teams to convert identified market needs into solutions.
  • Excellent oral, written and presentation communication skills.
  • Ability and flexibility to travel and work with customers and partners throughout the assigned geographical territory. Overnight travel as necessary to complete business requirements. Estimated 50% travel.
  • Ability to operate independently without frequent supervision or guidance.
  • Personal attributes to enable success in a dynamic organization: work ethic, persistence, tenacity, creativity, confidence, positive attitude, energy, team player, customer focus, resilience, stress tolerance, problem solving, flexibility, persuasiveness and the ability to take risks.
  • Strong computer skills including Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Fluent in spoken and written English, as well as Spanish and/or Portuguese.

description:
Overview

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications leader, built to help enterprises unlock the full potential of mobile connectivity at scale. Powered by a best-in-class telecom platform – including our own owned and operated global mobile core network, a full end-to-end eSIM technology stack, and an extensive portfolio of telecom licenses – 1GLOBAL operates as a fully regulated telecommunications provider across 40 countries worldwide. Combined with our privileged access to the global wholesale telecom market, this positions us uniquely to deliver seamless, compliant, and scalable connectivity solutions anywhere in the world.

We serve many of the world’s leading banks, enterprises, and digital-first businesses, including neo-banks, fast moving consumer goods companies, travel leaders, and payment service providers. Today, 1GLOBAL connects more than 70 million people and devices globally, enabling our customers to launch, scale, and innovate with confidence in the mobile ecosystem.

1GLOBAL is a profitable, fast-growing business. With full-year revenues exceeding US$200 million and profits of over US$25 million, we generate strong cash flows and fund our growth independently—continuously investing in infrastructure, platform innovation, and global expansion. Recent years have marked a defining phase in our journey, with major enterprise and mass-consumer client wins accelerating our evolution into a global mobile connectivity powerhouse, purpose-built to enable consumer brands to enter and succeed with their own telecommunications offerings.

Founded in 2022 by experienced technology entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios , 1GLOBAL has rapidly emerged as a European technology leader shaping the future of global telecommunications. We operate as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) in 12 countries and as a regulated telecom operator in an additional 28 markets. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, our team of close to 500 experts across 15 countries is united by a single ambition: to redefine global mobile connectivity through technology, scale, and execution excellence.

Position Overview

We are looking for a talented Senior DevSecOps / Cloud Security Engineer to join our Technology Department, with a focus on strengthening and automating our security posture across cloud and hybrid infrastructure.

As a DevSecOps / Cloud Security Engineer, you will be responsible for embedding security into every stage of our infrastructure lifecycle, from design to deployment. You will lead the implementation of cloud-native security controls in AWS, harden Kubernetes environments, and drive best practices across CI/CD pipelines. Your role includes continuous vulnerability management, network protection, monitoring for threats, and working with development, DevOps and IP teams to ensure secure-by-default practices. You’ll also proactively identify risks, secure network perimeters, and automate remediation wherever possible.

Fluency in English is essential for this role. Please ensure your CV is submitted in English as part of your application.

Key responsibilities
  • Design, implement, and evolve scalable cloud security controls across AWS multi-account environments using security-as-code principles
  • Own Kubernetes security architecture including workload isolation, RBAC, pod security standards, and network segmentation
  • Embed security automation into CI/CD pipelines, including image scanning, IaC validation, and policy enforcement
  • Continuously assess cloud and Kubernetes environments for vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and emerging threats
  • Design and maintain strong IAM and secrets management practices, enforcing least-privilege access
  • Partner with DevOps, Platform, and IP/Network teams to deliver security controls as code and by design
  • Analyze network traffic and security telemetry using flow logs, metrics, and targeted packet inspection where required
  • Ensure alignment with internal security policies and external frameworks (CIS, NIST, ISO 27001, etc.)
  • Produce and maintain clear documentation, including security architectures, runbooks, and incident response playbooks
  • Act as a security champion, driving best practices, awareness, and secure engineering culture across teams

Requirements

  • A minimum of 3+ years Cloud Security / DevSecOps / Infrastructure Security
  • Strong AWS security fundamentals (IAM, KMS, GuardDuty, Config, Security Hub)
  • Solid Linux security and cloud networking fundamentals
  • Hands-on Kubernetes security (RBAC, NetworkPolicies, pod security, image scanning)
  • Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and Git-based workflows
  • Scripting for automation (Python or Go or Bash)
  • Experience with vulnerability management and container security
  • Security-first mindset with strong troubleshooting skills
  • Experience with WAFs and cloud DDoS protection
  • Comfortable with packet inspection, flow analysis , and traffic monitoring (tcpdump, Wireshark, Suricata, etc.)

Benefits

What we offer?

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Extended parental leave - 180 days of maternity leave and 20 days of paternity leave.
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)!

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs.
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver’s seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry.
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals.
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts.
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field.
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company.
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment.
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry.

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

Prazer, somos a Petz: o melhor ecossistema do segmento pet

A Petz tem como propósito criar valor e proporcionar a melhor experiência possível na relação entre o pet e o seu tutor. E, para que isso seja possível, temos como visão sermos reconhecidos mundialmente, até 2025, como o melhor ecossistema do segmento pet.

Com uma estratégia omnicanal e que integra não só os canais físicos e digitais, mas também os segmentos de produtos e serviços, somos uma plataforma de soluções completa para os animais de estimação.

Nossa proposta é oferecer aos nossos clientes uma experiência de compra e atendimento diferenciado em nossas lojas físicas, além de agilidade e conveniência em nossos canais digitais. Sim, queremos estar presentes em todos os momentos da vida dos nossos clientes, tutores e pets.

Contamos, também, com a maior rede de centros de estética do Brasil e, sob a marca Seres , com a mais abrangente rede de centros veterinários do país; além de, por meio do maior programa nacional de adoção de cães e gatos, o Adote Petz , fomentamos a criação da conexão emocional do tutor com o seu novo melhor amigo.

E ainda nem falamos dos produtos da marca Petz , que já são mais de 300 itens disponíveis em todas as nossas lojas, sendo líder de vendas nas 25 categorias de produtos ofertados. Com um faturamento que cresce mais de 40% ao ano, isso mostra o quanto somos fortes, inovadores e entregamos produtos de qualidade aos nossos clientes.

E, aos poucos, esse ecossistema vem se expandindo e se fortalecendo com a chegada de grandes marcas do segmento junto ao grupo Petz, dentre elas: Zee.Dog , Cansei de Ser Gato, Cão Cidadão e Petix. Legal né?

Esta oportunidade de trabalho está aberta a qualquer pessoa independente de religião, cor, Pessoa com deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade ou expressão de gênero. O CIEDS é contrário a qualquer forma de discriminação e está comprometido com a inclusão, a diversidade e a igualdade de oportunidades. Se você acha que pode se beneficiar da nossa política de ação afirmativa, por favor informe na sua candidatura.

Acesse o edital na íntegra:

Resumo da Função

O Psicopedagogo exerce um papel essencial na promoção da inclusão escolar, atuando na construção de ambientes educacionais acolhedores e acessíveis a todos os alunos, independentemente de suas habilidades ou deficiências. Sua atuação é voltada tanto para o sucesso acadêmico quanto para o desenvolvimento emocional dos estudantes, contribuindo de forma significativa para uma educação mais inclusiva e equitativa.

Esse profissional é responsável por identificar e intervir precocemente em dificuldades de aprendizagem, realizando avaliações abrangentes que permitem compreender as necessidades específicas de cada aluno. A partir desse diagnóstico, o psicopedagogo elabora estratégias e planos de intervenção personalizados, que podem incluir metodologias diferenciadas de ensino, uso de recursos específicos e acompanhamento individualizado. Dessa forma, o psicopedagogo atua como um elo entre os aspectos cognitivos, emocionais e pedagógicos do processo de aprendizagem, favorecendo o desenvolvimento integral dos alunos e fortalecendo o compromisso da escola com a educação inclusiva e de qualidade.

Atribuições

  • Realizar intervenção psicopedagógica, visando a solução dos problemas de aprendizagem;
  • Realizar diagnóstico e intervenção psicopedagógica, mediante a utilização de instrumentos e técnicas próprios de Psicopedagogia;
  • Utilizar métodos, técnicas e instrumentos psicopedagógicos que tenham por finalidade a pesquisa, a prevenção, a avaliação e a intervenção relacionadas com a aprendizagem;
  • Prestar consultoria e assessoria psicopedagógicas aos profissionais das unidades educacionais, objetivando a identificação,a compreensão e a análise dos problemas no processo de aprendizagem;
  • Desenvolver atividades que ampliem a aprendizagem, por meio de jogos pedagógicos, da tecnologia, dentre outros;
  • Buscar a integração dos interesses, raciocínio e informações que fazem com que o aluno atue operativamente nos diferentes níveis de escolaridade;
  • Atuar para compreender os processos de desenvolvimento e das aprendizagens humanas, recorrendo a várias estratégias objetivando a resolução dos problemas que possam surgir;
  • Acompanhar o desenvolvimento do processo educacional dos estudantes das escolas municipais em sala de aula e, se necessário,em contraturno, conforme as necessidades específicas de cada estudante da rede municipal de educação de Macaé;
  • Apoiar os docentes, os profissionais de apoio escolar a inclusão, a equipe gestora e demais profissionais da unidade escolar onde atuará em todas as ações pedagógicas voltadas para o estudante com deficiência;
  • Valorizar e estimular a autonomia do estudante;
  • Exercer outras atividades inerentes à sua área de atuação que forem deferidas pela instituição;
  • Participar de reuniões de equipe para discussões de caso e alinhamento do serviço.

description:

Job Description Summary:

At The Coca-Cola Company, we are proud to be one of the world’s most recognized and respected brands, with a legacy spanning over 139 years and a portfolio enjoyed by millions of consumers every day across Latin America. Our mission is simple yet powerful: refresh the world and make a difference .

We are seeking a Sr. Director I, Portfolio Strategy, LATAM to architect and steward the long term strategic direction of the total beverage portfolio across the region. This role is pivotal in shaping portfolio vision, brand roles, category strategies, and innovation priorities—ensuring that our portfolio remains culturally relevant, competitively advantaged, and grounded in deep human understanding.

The ideal candidate brings a rare combination of strategic systems thinking, consumer and insights mastery, and executive influence . You will work at the intersection of Global strategy, the LATAM Operating Unit, and local markets, translating human needs, demand spaces, and segmentation into clear portfolio choices that unlock sustainable growth.

What You’ll Do for Us

  • Lead the end to end portfolio strategy for the LATAM Operating Unit , owning the long term vision, strategic ambition, and growth pathways across categories, brands, and price tiers.

  • Champion consumer centric and insight led decision making by translating human needs, demand spaces, and segmentation into actionable portfolio, category, and brand role choices.

  • Shape portfolio architecture and brand roles , guiding prioritization, simplification, innovation focus, and long range planning to maximize value creation.

  • Translate global portfolio ambition into a cohesive, regionally relevant strategy , balancing scale with cultural nuance and local market realities.

  • Own the portfolio governance framework for LATAM, including evaluation criteria, growth metrics, prioritization principles, and strategic guardrails.

  • Integrate foresight, predictive analytics, and emerging behavioral trends to identify future growth opportunities and inform long term portfolio direction.

  • Partner cross functionally with Marketing, RGM, Commercial, IMX, Innovation, and Strategy to shape OBPPC strategies rooted in consumer motivation, elasticity, and affordability dynamics.

  • Evaluate competitive performance and portfolio mix , informing choices on premiumization, affordability, penetration, and occasion expansion.

  • Enable markets with clear strategic foundations — segmentation, cohorts, architecture, and growth metrics—supporting strong local portfolio design and execution.

  • Influence system wide alignment by using clear, insight driven narratives to guide senior leadership, markets, and global stakeholders around portfolio choices.

  • Represent the LATAM consumer and competitive context in global portfolio forums , ensuring regional realities inform enterprise decisions.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing , Business, Economics, or a related field; MBA or Master’s degree preferred .

  • 12–15+ years of experience in Portfolio Strategy, Consumer Insights, Marketing Strategy, Innovation, Category Strategy, or RGM, with regional or multi market scope.

  • Proven expertise leading strategic frameworks , including segmentation, brand roles, portfolio architecture, and long term growth planning.

  • Strong background in CPG / FMCG , with experience shaping portfolio or category strategies at scale.

  • Deep capability in consumer insights, human needs, demand spaces, and growth analytics .

  • Demonstrated ability to simplify complexity and articulate clear strategic choices to senior leaders.

  • Strong executive presence with the ability to influence without direct authority in complex, matrixed organizations.

  • High cultural sensitivity and deep understanding of LATAM consumer dynamics .

  • Fluency in English and Spanish or Portuguese ; proficiency in all three is a strong advantage.

What We’ll Do for You

  • Enterprise Impact: Shape the long term portfolio vision for one of Coca Cola’s most dynamic and strategically important regions.

  • Iconic Brands: Influence a world class beverage portfolio across categories, occasions, and price tiers.

  • Global Exposure: Work closely with Global, OU, and market leadership, contributing LATAM perspective to enterprise strategy.

  • Growth & Learning: Be part of a learning organization that values strategic rigor, curiosity, and future ready thinking.

  • Purpose Driven Work: Help refresh the world and make a difference by shaping portfolios that truly connect with human needs.

Skills

Data Analysis, Decision Making, Executive Influence, Executive Leadership, Long Term Planning

Our Purpose and Growth Culture

We are taking deliberate action to nurture an inclusive culture that is grounded in our company purpose, to refresh the world and make a difference. We act with a growth mindset, take an expansive approach to what’s possible and believe in continuous learning to improve our business and ourselves. We focus on four key behaviors – curious, empowered, inclusive and agile – and value how we work as much as what we achieve. We believe that our culture is one of the reasons our company continues to thrive after 130+ years. Visit Our Purpose and Vision to learn more about these behaviors and how you can bring them to life in your next role at Coca-Cola.

title: Senior Full-stack (React Native/Java) Engineer - Health Care
description:
About Truelogic

At Truelogic we are a leading provider of nearshore staff augmentation services headquartered in New York. For over two decades, we’ve been delivering top-tier technology solutions to companies of all sizes, from innovative startups to industry leaders, helping them achieve their digital transformation goals.

Our team of 600+ highly skilled tech professionals, based in Latin America, drives digital disruption by partnering with U.S. companies on their most impactful projects. Whether collaborating with Fortune 500 giants or scaling startups, we deliver results that make a difference.

By applying for this position, you’re taking the first step in joining a dynamic team that values your expertise and aspirations. We aim to align your skills with opportunities that foster exceptional career growth and success while contributing to transformative projects that shape the future.

Our Client

This client is creating a fundamentally better healthcare experience for people with chronic health conditions and those who care for them. We make healthcare more accessible by simplifying complex care plans, connecting care teams, and meeting patients where they live. Through our conversational AI, patients use their voices to interact with our digital care companion, which proactively delivers medication reminders, symptom checks, behavioral nudges, and even engages in friendly conversation to ease loneliness. Cairns uses a device that includes radar to put the patient in context and passively monitors their activities, including heart rate, breathing rate, and sleep stages, all without a wearable. The result is informed, timely intervention that drives improved clinical outcomes, reduced care‑delivery costs, and a more satisfactory healthcare experience for all.

Job Summary

We’re seeking a dynamic software engineer to join our incredible engineering team at Cairns Health. The role sits at the crossroads of conversational AI, radar technology, hardware integration, and LLMs. You’ll play a pivotal role in the success of our product, starting with front‑end and back‑end development for our web and mobile apps using React and React Native, while exploring opportunities across our tech stack. Our ideal candidate is a proactive problem solver with a hands‑on approach to coding and a positive, can‑do attitude.

Responsibilities
  • Code daily to tackle challenges and drive our product to market.
  • Develop a backend architecture to support our mobile health and wellness app for seniors.
  • Design and develop mobile app features that serve our users.
  • Optimize our mobile app for latency, concurrency, uptime, etc.
  • Take a leading role in creating interactive, data‑driven mobile and web apps using a modern tech stack.
  • Enhance our backend to power front‑end and device features.
  • Collaborate with a team of accomplished, high‑performing engineers.
  • Beyond app development, gain hands‑on experience with embedded devices, front‑end, back‑end, AWS, and Kubernetes.
Qualifications and Job Requirements
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field or equivalent practical experience, coupled with 3‑5 years of professional experience as a Full Stack Software Engineer or in a similar role.
  • Proficient in React and React Native for building responsive and mobile‑first user interfaces, with strong experience in Redux for effective state management.
  • Proficient in Java 11+ for developing robust server‑side applications and experienced in designing and implementing RESTful APIs to facilitate seamless integration between front‑end and back‑end systems.
  • Hands‑on experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases, ensuring efficient data storage, retrieval, and management for scalable applications.
  • Proficient in containerization using Docker and orchestration with Kubernetes, with a proven track record of deploying and managing applications on AWS EKS (Elastic Kubernetes Service) and ECS (Elastic Container Service).
  • Familiarity with messaging systems like Kafka and MQTT for real‑time data processing and communication, along with proficiency in using GitHub for version control and collaborative development.
  • Experience implementing and managing CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or similar tools, familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies for iterative and collaborative software development, and strong problem‑solving and analytical abilities to tackle complex technical challenges.
  • Positive, team player with strong people skills and excellent communication.
What We Offer
  • 100% Remote Work: Enjoy the freedom to work from the location that helps you thrive. All it takes is a laptop and a reliable internet connection.
  • Highly Competitive USD Pay: Earn an excellent, market‑leading compensation in USD, that goes beyond typical market offerings.
  • Paid Time Off: We value your well‑being. Our paid time off policies ensure you have the chance to unwind and recharge when needed.
  • Work with Autonomy: Enjoy the freedom to manage your time as long as the work gets done. Focus on results, not the clock.
  • Work with Top American Companies: Grow your expertise working on innovative, high‑impact projects with Industry‑Leading U.S. Companies.
Why You’ll Like Working Here
  • A Culture That Values You: We prioritize well‑being and work‑life balance, offering engagement activities and fostering dynamic teams to ensure you thrive both personally and professionally.
  • Diverse, Global Network: Connect with over 600 professionals in 25+ countries, expand your network, and collaborate with a multicultural team from Latin America.
  • Team Up with Skilled Professionals: Join forces with senior talent. All of our team members are seasoned experts, ensuring you’re working with the best in your field.

The Mindrift platform connects specialists with AI projects from major tech innovators. Our mission is to unlock the potential of Generative AI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

GenAI models are improving very quickly, and one of our goals is to make them capable of addressing specialized questions and achieving complex reasoning skills. If you join the platform as a Machine Learning expert, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate on these projects.

description:
Somos uma startup de IA criada para o varejo - e estamos procurando profissionais de varejo.

A STOREE.AI é uma startup em crescimento que leva IA para lojas físicas de forma prática e pé no chão.

Ajudamos organizações de varejo a conduzir melhor as operações do dia a dia - comunicação, tarefas, prioridades, acompanhamentos e KPIs - usando uma IA que funciona como um ótimo gestor.

Você não precisa ter background técnico.

Sem experiência com software. Sem conhecimento em IA.

Se você entende como o varejo realmente funciona - pessoas, pressão, execução e tomada de decisão - você já tem exatamente o que buscamos.

Você traz a experiência de varejo.

A STOREE.AI é usada diariamente por mais de 100 redes de lojas no mundo.

A plataforma

A plataforma fica no centro das operações da loja e ajuda gestores a :

  • Comunicar com clareza com lojas e equipes
  • Transformar prioridades em tarefas executáveis
  • Fazer follow-up de forma automática e consistente
  • Acompanhar performance e KPIs em tempo real
  • Treinar e orientar equipes no trabalho do dia a dia, não em apresentações

Ela é familiar para quem é do varejo, porque foi construída em torno de como os bons gestores já operam - só que mais rápido, mais claro e em escala.

Por que a experiência de varejo importa

Nossa plataforma é poderosa, mas varejo não é “tamanho único”.

O que importa para uma rede de moda não é o mesmo que importa para um supermercado.

O que um líder de VM procura é diferente do que HR / RH ou Operações procuram.

Por isso, não estamos buscando vendedores tradicionais.

O que buscamos

Estamos buscando profissionais seniores de varejo que consigam :

  • Entender as necessidades reais de uma organização de varejo
  • Falar a linguagem do varejo, não buzzwords
  • Conduzir conversas com credibilidade e profundidade

Isso é desenvolvimento de negócios baseado em entendimento, não em “pitch”.

O que você vai fazer na prática

Construir relacionamentos com organizações de varejo relevantes

Conduzir o processo ou passar para nosso time central quando necessário

Influenciar a direção do produto - você será nosso olhar de varejo dentro da empresa

Você não vai “vender software”.

Você vai conectar experiência com soluções reais.

Para quem é

Líderes seniores de varejo, incluindo :

  • Gerentes de loja, distrito e regional
  • Líderes de HQ em operações, RH, treinamento, VM, CX ou excelência no varejo

Qualquer pessoa que já liderou equipes de varejo e quer dar o próximo passo.

Se você já pensou

A tecnologia não entende de verdade o que acontece nas lojas” - nós concordamos.

Foi exatamente por isso que criamos a STOREE.AI.

O que oferecemos
  • Treinamento completo - não é necessário background técnico
  • Trabalho remoto com horários flexíveis
  • Remuneração por comissão, com possibilidade de efetivação full-time
  • Chance de entrar antes de uma grande escala global
  • Tecnologia real, já funcionando no campo

Isso não é um emprego.

É uma segunda carreira.

De comandar lojas para ajudar a definir como as lojas serão comandadas.

Quer começar direto? Inicie o processo aqui.

title: Google Cloud Engagement Manager
description:
Job Title : Google Cloud Engagement Manager

Duration : 6-Month Contract

Compensation : To be confirmed (Range : $28 - $33 USD per hour)

Job Description

We are seeking a strategic and results-driven Google Cloud Engagement Manager to lead and manage the joint "sell-with" go-to-market engagement and all partnership activities with Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This role is central to driving qualified pipeline, customer engagements, and cloud bookings that exceed targets. The successful candidate will act as the primary conduit between our sales organization and GCP, requiring expert-level knowledge, strong leadership, and the ability to operate within a complex, matrixed environment.

Key Responsibilities
  • Manage all joint "sell-with" and go-to-market strategies and activities with Google Cloud.
  • Track, report, and forecast opportunities, pipeline, and bookings; provide comprehensive funnel management reports.
  • Facilitate co-selling engagements, account mapping, and joint sales activities between our field sales teams and GCP sales teams.
  • Support and enable the field sales organization in all GCP-related engagement management.
  • Contribute to and help develop content for Google Cloud sales training curriculum and enablement programs.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional virtual teams (Business Development, Marketing, Product Management, Channels) as part of the overarching cloud strategy.
  • Develop and own the annual strategic plan and performance goals for the GCP partnership.
  • Provide support and coordination for joint channel activities and programs.
  • Develop a deep understanding of Google Cloud's strategic initiatives, roadmap, and vision.
  • Serve as an escalation point for pre-sales and post-sales issues related to GCP engagements.
  • Build and maintain strong executive and working relationships with key personnel at GCP.
  • Provide insights, support, and active participation in key Google Cloud events.
  • Act as a subject matter expert, presenting at QBRs, executive meetings, and internal training sessions.
Required Skills & Experience
  • BA / BS degree or equivalent work experience; MBA preferred.
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in Sales, Account Management, or Channel Management.
  • Demonstrated history of managing quota-bearing sales or channel teams.
  • Strong preference for candidates with Public Cloud experience (specifically GCP).
  • Channel experience, including selling with or managing channel partners, is highly preferred.
  • Solid industry knowledge of security product market trends; familiarity with competitive security landscapes is a plus.
  • Proven ability to work effectively in a virtual, matrixed environment.
  • Excellent communication (written and verbal) and presentation skills.
  • Proactive, "whatever it takes" attitude with a strong motivation to drive business wins.
  • Ability to travel internationally approximately 25% of the time.
